test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ________ model who can be selected for this advertisement is Meera Narayan.
solution:
The correct answer is '**best**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**best**" is the superlative form of "**good**."
 
• The sentence requires a superlative form to indicate that Meera Narayan is the most suitable model for the advertisement.
 
• **Options 1, 2, and 3** are grammatically incorrect because they do not form valid superlative adjectives.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The **best**__ model who can be selected for this advertisement is Meera Narayan."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "more better"** is incorrect because "better" is already a comparative form, and adding "more" creates redundancy.
 
• **Option 2: "most best"** is incorrect because "best" is already a superlative form, and adding "most" creates redundancy.
 
• **Option 3: "most good"** is incorrect because "good" does not take "most" for forming its superlative; instead, it becomes "best."
